artworks.title: Warriors Lifting the Body of Patroclus (Etruscan relief)
artworks.description: Florence MAN relief of the fight for Patroclus’ corpse: tradition and modern labels place Meriones beside Menelaus among the Greeks who raise the body — Iliad XVII’s Cretan comrade of Idomeneus caught in Etruscan stone.

popCulture.title: Iliad (Meriones)
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Homer’s Meriones — son of Molus, peer of Enyalius, Idomeneus’ dearest comrade — captains the hindmost Cretan ships and fights through the Patroclus books as a named spearman of the Achaean line.
